name: Department of Archaeology — gazetted protected monuments, Chattogram Division (district PDF lists)
organization: প্রত্নতত্ত্ব অধিদপ্তর (Department of Archaeology), Ministry of Cultural Affairs
attribution: প্রত্নতত্ত্ব অধিদপ্তর (Department of Archaeology), Ministry of Cultural Affairs
notes: Page 'চট্টগ্রাম বিভাগের সংরক্ষিত পুরাকীর্তি' links one PDF per district for 7 districts (64 monuments 'আগস্ট ২০২৬ পর্যন্ত'; lists published 2024-08-31, Chattogram 2026-08-31); Rangamati, Cox's Bazar, Khagrachhari and Bandarban are listed with 'সংরক্ষিত পুরাকীর্তি নেই' (written as 0 in facts.csv). PDFs mix Bijoy/SutonnyMJ text (converted to Unicode by fetch.py, bijoy2uni) and, for two Chattogram rows, a broken Unicode text layer or a page without the table header; those rows were read from the rendered pages (ROW_FIXES_BY_DIV['chattogram']). Photo captions are dropped. Coordinates are the DoA's own GPS column (DMS, parsed; a latitude label 'D.' printed one column to the right is re-attached); one unparseable value is kept in extra_json only. QA against hdx_cod_ab_bgd_chattogram polygons. Descriptions (column 7) are not copied; only a construction-date phrase is kept. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
